settings.tagline: Strength training and classes in Baneshwor

props.about: Barbells, dumbbells to 50 kg, two squat racks and a small cardio floor. Open from 5:30 am so you can train before the office.

pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Iron Yak Fitness, Baneshwor: strength gym, classes and coaches
pages.seoDescription: Strength gym in Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Monthly from Rs 3,000, morning batch from 5:30 am. Free trial day, no card needed.

props.title: Lift heavy. Go to work.
props.text: Two squat racks, real plates, a coach on the floor from 6 to 9 in the morning and 5 to 8 in the evening.

image.alt: A wall of black kettlebells in a dark gym

items.label: Squat racks, so no queue at 6 pm
Doors open, every day but Saturday

items.title: Strength floor
items.text: Racks, benches, deadlift platforms, chalk allowed. Programmes on paper if you want one.

items.title: Conditioning class
items.text: Forty minutes, kettlebells and sleds, Sunday to Friday at 6:30 am and 6 pm.

items.title: Beginner basics
items.text: Four sessions with a coach on squat, hinge, press and pull before you are left alone with a barbell.

items.title: Personal training
items.text: One-to-one, twelve sessions, with a written plan and a food chart that fits dal-bhat.

image.alt: A barbell loaded with plates beside a squat rack
A lifter gripping a barbell overhead
Rows of black dumbbells on a rack

props.heading: Bikash Gurung, 11 years on the floor
props.body: Bikash lifted at the national powerlifting meet in Pokhara and now runs the beginner sessions himself. He will tell you when you are ready to add weight, and when you are not.

props.title: Come once, no forms, no card
props.text: Your first day is free. Bring shoes and a towel.
